description: Each student's current diet: published plans (since when, meals, adherence of the week) and drafts the trainer saved but never published to a student who has no active diet yet, with student name and the app_url of that student's diet screen. Use it to answer "who is still waiting for the diet I wrote?"; get_diet_plan shows the plan, and activate_diet_plan publishes it only after the trainer says so.
name: get_active_diets
title: See students diets
